title: SharePos
description: Quickly send your coordinates to a friend in a clickable form.
body:
# Quickly send your coordinates to a friend in a clickable form.
[![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f0593030d86328653a4d4cd9226da351e6846cc.png)](https://discord.gg/RPq4y9hKY7)

**SharePos is a lightweight Spigot plugin that allows players to quickly and easily share their coordinates with other players on the server. The plugin creates clickable coordinate messages in chat that can be copied to clipboard with a single click, making navigation and meetups between players much more convenient.**

## Key Features

**Easy Coordinate Sharing**
- Share your current location with specific players or everyone on the server
- Coordinates appear as clickable green text in chat
- One click copies coordinates to clipboard for easy pasting

**Smart Permission System**
- Regular players can share coordinates with individuals
- Players with `sharepos.all` permission can broadcast to everyone
- Server operators have additional privileges and no cooldowns

**Anti-Spam Protection**
- 15-second cooldown between uses for regular players
- Operators bypass cooldown restrictions
- Prevents coordinate spam in chat

**Operator Features**
- Share any player's coordinates with everyone using `/sharepos <player> all`
- No cooldown restrictions
- Special help menu with additional commands

**User-Friendly Interface**
- Multiple command aliases: `/sharepos`, `/sp`, `/pos`
- Comprehensive help system with different guides for operators and regular players
- Clear error messages and usage instructions
- Hover tooltips show world information

## Commands

- `/sharepos <player>` - Share your coordinates with a specific player
- `/sharepos all` - Share your coordinates with all players (requires permission)
- `/sharepos help` - Display help information
- `/sharepos <target> all` - (OP only) Share target player's coordinates with everyone

## Permissions

- `sharepos.use` - Basic permission to use the plugin (default: true)
- `sharepos.all` - Permission to share coordinates with all players (default: op)

## Technical Details

This plugin is designed for Minecraft 1.21.x servers running Spigot or Paper. It uses the modern Spigot API for clickable text components and requires no additional dependencies. The plugin is lightweight with minimal performance impact and includes proper error handling for edge cases.

The coordinate sharing system respects player privacy - only coordinates are shared, not exact player locations or other sensitive information. All shared coordinates include world information to prevent confusion in multi-world setups.

Perfect for survival servers, creative building projects, or any server where players need to coordinate locations efficiently.
